model.name: T-remove-id-full-wipe: removeLocalIdentity clears ALL browser state → first-run → ProfileEditor
model.description: R19.91 fix: removeLocalIdentity MUST (1) clear ALL identity browser state — localStorage (token, keypair, device data, name, secret), IndexedDB entries, any cached identity in SW caches; (2) reset app to first-run (no token/device/profile); (3) reload → ProfileEditor in new-user onboarding mode. Currently a partial clear leaves residual state preventing a true fresh start. Refines R19.89 (button placement now correct → action must be complete). Singular-chain: ONE UseCase per Task; ONE Method per UseCase (learning #27). Architect to design the UC. NOTE (anti-false-green standard): Test node must be a real END-TO-END Playwright test reaching the rendered view + screenshot, not a unit/source-string test.
